# Fixture documents

Page-aligned TXT files used by the offline index. PDF and grid folders exist so path construction matches production.

| Folder | Role |
|---|---|
| `txt/` | Native page text for FIX001 through FIX008, except the missing FIX003 file. |
| `pdf/` | Empty placeholder matching production layout. |
| `grids/` | Empty placeholder matching production layout. |
